# discord_prune_members (Action)

Removes members who have not been active for a number of days. By default only members without roles are removed. With `dry_run`, the action reports how many members would be removed and removes nobody. Requires the Manage Server and Kick Members permissions, or Administrator when the server has the `PRUNE_REQUIRES_ADMIN` feature.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run with: terraform apply -invoke=action.discord_prune_members.inactive
action "discord_prune_members" "inactive" {
  config {
    server_id        = var.server_id
    days             = 30
    include_role_ids = [discord_role.visitor.id]
    dry_run          = true # report the count without removing anyone
    audit_log_reason = "Inactive for 30 days"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Optional

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for this action, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters.
- `compute_prune_count` (Boolean) Whether Discord counts the removed members. Discord recommends `false` for large servers. Defaults to `true`. Ignored with `dry_run`.
- `days` (Number) Days of inactivity, from 1 to 30. Discord defaults to 7.
- `dry_run` (Boolean) Report how many members would be removed without removing any. Defaults to `false`.
- `include_role_ids` (Set of String) Roles whose members can also be removed. A member is removed only when every role they have is in this set.
